newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 24.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.47 (-.01)

A ruling on Monday by the High Court on a Cape York aboriginal land claim which found that pastoral leases did not always extinguish native title has some miners warning that the ruling will stall development on the 40 percent of Australia covered by pastoral leases and scare off potential investors because of uncertainty and legal costs.

Advance Bank shareholders on Monday overwhelmingly approved the A$2.65 billion takeover of their bank by St George and despite earlier contradictory responses, the Australian Securities Commission said it would not oppose the scheme of arrangement for the merger at a scheduled Supreme Court hearing on January 6

Coles Myer said on Monday it had sold A$558 million of its retail property to various interests including Westfield Trust with the money reaped from the sale to be used to reduce debt in the company to within its target range of 55 to 60 per cent.
Brambles on Monday announced a A$111 million takeover bid for computer and office services company Ausdoc at a price of A$2.00 per share, a 23 percent premium to Ausdoc's closing price of A$1.63.
